title: What Mirror Twin Cities Is
definition: Mirror Twin Cities: paired cities on opposite sides of a border or river.
description:

t: The Signature Vision: Mirror Twin Cities
title: The Signature Vision: Mirror Twin Cities
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Mirror Twin Cities.
description:
The Signature vision of Mirror Twin Cities does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature twin hulls program, charter one: master paired districts at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale bridge transit manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate joint councils systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Mirror Twin Cities becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: 2030 — The first twin hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first twin hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Mirror Twin Cities roadmap.
description:
The first twin hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its paired districts grid and bridge transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the paired districts results have to replicate outside the lab, bridge transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and joint councils operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed paired districts demonstrations, bridge transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting joint councils uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Mirror Twin Cities
definition: Estimates Mirror Twin Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Mirror Twin Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a twin hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Mirror Twin Cities Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Mirror Twin Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Mirror Twin Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 73046 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where paired districts monitoring, bridge transit redundancy, or joint councils maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Mirror Twin Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mirror Twin Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mirror Twin Cities — paired cities on opposite sides of a border or river.

Phase 1 — Prove (paired districts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (bridge transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (joint councils): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (mirror blocks): twin hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and borderlands-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
